finding: The 1911 printed compilation of Carver, Massachusetts town vital records records Clarissa Cobb (27 March 1786) as a child of Barnabas and Jerusha Cobb. Philip L. Cobb's 1907 family history independently *identifies* this Carver-born Clarissa as Capt. Matthew Beverage's wife of Hope.
limitations: The 1911 book transcribes a town record; the original handwritten Carver entry and Matthew–Clarissa marriage return remain uninspected. The identity bridge to the probate widow relies on a later compiled genealogy, so this is not a firsthand record of the marriage. No biological maternity for Matthew's court-named children follows.
